nom: Dermalogica Biolumin-C Vitamin C Eye Serum

avis.texte: I am an adult woman and it works perfectly for me. After applying it, I use my highlighter and it doesn't create any creases or lines under my eyes at all. I've been using it for three months and I give it a 10 out of 10.

avis.titre: works well as a base eye product
avis.texte: This serum is a great start to my eye routine. I use this after a dermalogica toner, then layer the Power firm eye cream with it during the day, and with a more moisturizing eye cream at night. Using this has made my eye area smoother and brighter.
I've been using at night for a week and my under eye area is much smoother.
Nice, light eye serum. It is not sticky and is compatible with all the other eye creams I have used.

Love it!!! I originally received this serum has a sampleâ€¦You only need a little dab. Goes a long way leaving your eyes hydrated and very smooth. I apply eye after I let the serum sit for a minute or two. Will definitely purchase this item againâ€¦ Well worth it exclamation exclamation.

So i think it did brighten my under eye area very slightly but unfortunately I did not notice a huge difference. I think I expected for my dark circles to lighten drastically and that did not occur. Overall for the price I spent, I can not recommend this product to anyone else. I also do not use everyday but more like 2x a week due to the fact I started to notice milia underneath my eye getting larger.

avis.titre: I would recommend this product to brighten the undereyes
avis.texte: This product helps with dark under eye circles. It minimizes it.

The prduct works really well! I use both morning and night and saw the brightening effects of it relatively quickly. Maybe about two weeks? It is quite a loose consistency, more like a serum. My only con would be is that my eyes get super dry (not from the product) but because of the consistency it doesn't moisturize as much as I need it to on my really bad days. I pair it with the Good Molecules brightening eye cream for the bad days and they both go on wonderfully together. Would definitely recommend. This can be your only eye product as long as you dont struggle with dry eyes like me. :)

I have been usong Dermalogica Multivitamin Power Firm for a few years and I really love but I wanted to try this produce for my dark circles. It is very watery and it has the consistency of Olay Vitamin C serum, but more watered down. I have been using it for 2 weeks with no results hopefully I start to see some brighten effects soon. I would not buy again especially with the price, I was hoping to get more out of this product not just a pricey knock off of vitamin c serum. I will be going back to the multivitamin power firm. If i see any results I will give an update!
Dried my skin out. Was flaky. Made the appearance look worse. Horrible product. I used for two months to give it a fair chance. Save your money. Do not buy.

Excellent eye serum. I already notice a difference in the even tone under my eyes. The dark circles I used to have are noticeably lighter. It takes a tiny drop each morning and night to lighten, brighten and soften the skin.
The only eye serum that actually gets rid of puffiness and make me look awake.
I love this product! I stopped using it for awhile and could tell a difference! I am back to daily use!
I've loved it since i first try it. It's so light weight and smooth.
This is amazing! It brightened my under eye after wearing for 2 weeks. RUN AND GET THIS!
I am 32 years old and this serum helps the skin around my eyes look much younger, brighter, and hydrated.
Light weight and cooling to my eyes. Wakes me up in the morning and you only need to use a small amount. Ita brightening my under eye area, and I just stated using it.
As a guy you don't really think about using eye serum, but I can't deny my eyes have never looked as bright and healthy.
So far I'm happy with this product. I only use it at night and it doesn't bother my skin. A little goes a long way!
I am new to this product but feel like it brightens my eyes when I use it. I use it every morning after washing, toning and moisturizing. A little dab will do you. I like it.

This is my go to product for under eye issues. I have very dark circles and lots of fine lines. It dramatically diminished the darkness and softened the lines in just a few applications. I now use regularly and it literally took years off my face.
I have been using this for a couple of weeks and it has been hydrating under the eyes and perfect to layer makeup over!

A little too early to tell how well this works for me. The texture is thinner than I'm used to, but that's not necessarily bad. Its absorbs nicely, and a little bit goes a long way. I've only been using it for about a week, but so far I like it.
This stuff really works. Definitely lightens hyperpigmentation around the eyes.

Love the brightening benefits around the eyes- especially the eyelids. The result is a youthful appearance. The airtight tube is fabulous and easy to use. I have been using Dermalogica for twenty years and their products are exceptional.

avis.titre: Eyes have never looked so good
avis.texte: Worth every penny! My eyes have never looked so bright and healthy
This is a nice light serum I've been using for only about 2 weeks so not sure if I see any brightening of my dark circles yet. I'll keep using and see. The hydration feels wonderful
I use it in the mornings and it seems like it's working. It doesn't break me out either. I'll update my review in 3 months if I see my dark circles disappearing.

This eye serum is absolutely fantastic. I have uneven, Indian, 40-year-old eyes with classically dark circles under my eyes. This serum is literally the only product I have ever used that lightened up the circles. I keep it in my mini beauty fridge to keep it cold, and I press the bottle very lightly to get a half-pea sized drop for both eyes. BE CAREFUL WHEN PRESSING THE BOTTLE because a huge glob WILL come out and that's a total waste. This product lightened my under-eyes to the point where I had to select a different shade of concealer. It's amazing! I wait a minute or so for the product to absorb, then I follow up with an eye cream, day and night.

I have naturally dark skin around my eyes from genetics and it's always been an insecurity. I was recommended this product and was very skeptical, and also was nervous about taking a risk on something so pricey. But I'm so glad I did! Don't get me wrong, I still have darker skin around my eyes, but it's atleast 3xs lighter and I no longer look like I have "raccoon eyes." I've also been using dermalogica's exfoliator (safely around my eyes and I have sensitive skin) that may be helping as well. Regardless, I noticed extreme results within about a week and a half.
I got so excited when i saw the reviews i got it i did not see any difference also, does not look good with makeup and so expensive for that poor product

I have tried several other brands, and found this to keep hydration and soften lines around eye area. Most importantly, it Doesn't dry me out like others! I no issues with negative skin reaction. Sold.
Was disappointed at the breakout around my eyes, for a product designed to put around your eyes. Was pricey too!
Love this product. It is reducing visible signs of crow's feet around me eyes. Easy to apply. No drop is wasted.

I use this eye serum twice daily and love it. I notice the brightening quality the most and I just feel more awake after using it in the morning. My one complaint is that the tube does not have a tight seal when you close it -- it does not travel well and I've had to stop taking it with me when I fly because the pressure build up causes the serum to explode all over my stuff.
I love it! Use every morning for dark circles around the eye. Small amount of Bio C dabbed on and then smoothed out with cool tip applicator of stress positive eye left - feels great!
I tried another brand for awhile but I'm back to Dermalogica.
I absolutely love this product, I have noticed a definite improvement on reducing dark circles & reduction in fine lines
Provides good hydration and smooths out the skin around the eyes. Like that it is in a tube and not a jar that gets exposed to air every time you use it.
Love my eye serum! Personally I see results as soon as I use it. It brightens and hydrates. I wish the C-12 was still available. Hoping they bring it back!
Product is okay. I'm not noticing a brightening effect, and I've been using the product for two weeks. Very expensive for what it is, what it does. Likely will not repurchase.
I love all you products because they are gluten free and I am a celiac

The feel of the product is nice, not heavy or sticky but also not watered down. I did notice some brightening. I do feel like I need to layer with a moisturizing product as well, especially if applying concealer.
Absolutely love this serum. My eye area already looks and feels better after just a couple of weeks!
Love this product. Makes my eye area look and feel more smooth.
Just love the way it feels when applying. And is not greasey.

First time I purchase this eye cream and I love it. I use it every morning and it helps with the morning puffiness around my eyes. It goes on very light and my skin absorbs it quickly. I recommend this eye cream. I will definitely be purchasing again.

I have loved all Dermalogica products so far, but this one didn't do it for me. Thankfully, I had a sample of the Stress Positive Eye product, which I've come back for. Sadly, I didn't know until it was too late that I could have returned a product.

As a real fen of some Dermaligica products I must admit that this product do not achieve the the promises. At list not for me. The skin around the eye make the grooves looks dipper and definitely not brighten the brown shadow around the eye.
I love how this feels on my eyes. I am 35 and feel this has helped me look less tired after having two kids :)
Love this serum. I'm a fan of vitamin c eye products and this is a great one.
Great product! Smooth and easy to apply. Leaves my skin looking awesome and bright! Just fab a little.

The biolumin-c serum is remarkable, it made my dark circles and redness completely disappear in a matter of a day. I love this serum so much, I wish I had started using it sooner. It is now a staple in my dermalogica lineup!
This works beautifully in the morning, very well under makeup. Feels very hydrating
I've been using this for about 1 year, and my dark circles are nearly non-existent. I believe in this product!
I love this light weight serum, leaves my eye area feeling smooth and silky. Must have product.

avis.titre: Finally found something for dark circles
avis.texte: I was NOT gifted this, I paid for it after loving several other dermalogica products. I was on the fence for awhile and skeptical about how many people were gifted it. I've had issues with dark circles my whole life but they've been worse the last few years with age. I was amazed at the difference this has made with brightening under my eyes. I've been using it since July and I still love it. It doesn't make up for a night with little sleep but overall my eyes are brighter. I've also noticed that it's lightened the 2 dark sun spots I have next to my eye. I do feel it works and have recommended it to my friends and family. I only use a small pea amount under each eye at night. Squeeze slowly bc it has a tendency come out in a big glob which is then wasteful. I'm not sure how it would look under makeup but from the way it dries on my skin, I believe it would be fine. I did see some negative reviews about the way it dried but I'm wondering if there's an interaction with other products. Full disclosure: I've also been using this with Sunday Riley's Good Genes which also contributes to lightening dark spots.
This serum lives up to its name for brightening and freshening up the eyes. Easy to use, a little goes a long way, so don't let the cost turn you off. Vitamin C does wonders for skin.
I wish I had stated this Vitamin c eye earlier. Could not believe how it brightened area under eye overnight.
Love this product! My eyes definitely appear firmer with fewer lines.
So far I have not drastically noticed a difference. I share this product with my husband and he usually has â€œtiredâ€ eyes and said he felt relief after the first use.
I like the eye serum, when I put it under my eyes they feel tied and looking less puffy. I'm hoping with time it will improve the fine wrinkles
Product goes a long way, only need very little. My first time trying this product and so far I love it.
This eye serum has a perfect texture that just melts into the skin. If you're thinking about it, buy it!! You won't regret it!
This product has made such a difference! I was hesitant to try it due to the price of the product, but so glad I did!
Hoping this helps with the melisma under my eyes!! What happened to dermalogica's eye sunscreen??!! :dollar:
It is a fun product to use, feels good on my face. My under eye has gotten brighter but not to the extant I hoped it would.

I have enjoyed using this eye cream for almost a year now. I love the lightweight moisture that it provides, and it doesn't irritate my extremely sensitive eyelids (I have blepharitis). However, I am going to be looking for a new eye product because unfortunately, this is unwearable under makeup and tinted moisturizers. It peels off under them, even if they're applied to my skin hours after putting on the serum. This leads me to believe that it's not getting fully absorbed. This serum is too expensive to only be able to wear it at night. And, for the price, I feel it should be more brightening. Also, too much product comes out even with the gentlest squeeze. This is great for nighttime, but I won't be using it anymore.
This serum is very light weight and has enough hydration in it. This eye serum very easy to dab around the eyes.
I love the way it makes the fine line, dark circles, and bagginess disaappear!!
My skin looks brighter! Healthy. Plump I use at night Quality is top notch!

avis.titre: Use it daily - Not sue it actually lightens
avis.texte: This is my current go-to eye cream. Before this I was using the Dermalogica multivitamin power firm eye cream. I tried this because I thought the darkness of my under eyes was of more concern than firmness. It's hydrating, feels nice and refreshing when applying, but I'm not sure it's brightened my under-eyes at all. I didn't see a visible difference in color after switching from the power firm eye cream. I feel it's as much, if not more, moisturizing than the power firm eye cream. And I prefer the lightweight feel and quick absorbency rate of this one. But again, I don't think it improved the color. I'm saying 'think' because maybe the color would be worse if I didn't use any eye cream at all? But there hasn't been an improvement. That being said, it's still my favorite to date.
Great help after working 2 back to back mountain destination weddings

I was surprised at how much I have ended up liking this product. It's brighten and smoothed my under eye more than I really thought. It's also a nice booster to Biolumen-c face serum. This product fits nicely in my Dermalogica family favs!
